S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  IA No.3/2024 (Short Term Bail Application)
 IN  CRLA No.153 of 2021  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Ayush Agrawal, learned counsel for the appellant.
2. Mr. Rakesh Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. This is an appeal under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. against the judgment and order dated 15.03.2021 passed by Special Judge (POCSO), Pithoragarh, in Special Sessions Trial No.15 of 2019, whereby appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:-
S.No. Conviction Sentence Fine Sentence in- lieu of fine 1. 376(2) Life Rs.10,000/- Six months' IPC Imprisonment additional imprisonment 2. 363 IPC 07 years' R.I. Rs.10,000/- Six months' additional imprisonment 3. 366 IPC 10 years' R.I. Rs.10,000/- Six months' additional imprisonment
All the sentences were directed to run concurrently.
4. Appellant has sought short term bail on the ground of marriage of his younger sister.
As per invitation card, annexed with the short term bail application, marriage is to be solemnized on 19.02.2024.
As per annexure-1 to the short term bail application, appellant is in jail continuously since 10.03.2019.

CRLA/153/2021 on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181790494/
1
5. Learned State Counsel was asked to get instructions as to correctness of the ground taken by the appellant for seeking short term bail.
6. Learned State Counsel on instructions has submitted that marriage of appellant's sister is scheduled for 19.02.2024.
7. We, accordingly, allow the short term bail application.

Let the appellant-Pradeep Kumar be enlarged on short term bail only for a period of 10 days from the date of his release, on his executing personal bond with two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Judicial Magistrate, Sitarganj (U.S. Nagar).
8.

Upon expiry of 10 days, appellant shall surrender before the Judicial Magistrate,
Sitarganj (U.S. Nagar).
9.

(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
16.02.2024 AK CRLA/153/2021 on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181790494/
